package.name: nuxeo-ai-operations
package.title: Nuxeo AI Operations (HAIP)
package.description:
AI-powered Nuxeo Automation Operations backed by the Hyland AI Platform (HAIP / LiteLLM). Provides AI.Summarize, AI.Insights, AI.SuggestTags, AI.Classify, AI.Chat, AI.NlToNxql, AI.Sentiment, AI.Similar, AI.Anomalies, AI.NlPermissions, AI.AuditNlFilter, and AI.AuditSummarize operations callable via the Automation REST API.
After installation, add your HAIP API key to nuxeo.conf: haip.api.key=sk-... haip.base.url=https://ai-platform-public.api.ai.dev.app.hyland.com haip.model=anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0 haip.model.fast=amazon.nova-micro-v1:0
